post.title: [Hiring] $30-50 looking for a couple simple logos for a local hiking group
post.body: Hello! Im looking to hire someone to help draw a couple simplistic but stylized nature oriented logos for my local hiking club! Im really flexible and open to creative decisions, I just want to make some nice logos without invoking Abominable Intelligence. Look forward to working with you!

analysis.summary: Looking for an artist to design a couple simple, nature-oriented logos for a local hiking group.

expect: mentions simple, stylised nature logos for a hiking club
does not offer AI-generated artwork (the poster explicitly asks for none)
cites the campus cafe brand project honestly as a student project, with one link
